name: Seattle
local_rules: Seattle Municipal Court adjudicates parking infractions and traffic notices. You must request a mitigation or contested hearing within 30 days of ticket issue (33 days if mailed). After a hearing is scheduled, you may submit a written statement and evidence by mail to Seattle Municipal Court, ATTN: Magistrate Operations, PO Box 34987, Seattle, WA 98124-4987. Written statements sent without a scheduled hearing will not be reviewed; the court will set a hearing and send the appropriate form.
